name: NDI still on a web page: read me
info:
Takes a JPEG still of an NDI source every 5 seconds and serves the newest one at
`<httpNodeRoot>/ndi-example/still.jpg` (with default settings: http://<node-red>:1880/ndi-example/still.jpg).

1. Open the **ndi thumbnail** node, press **Find sources** and pick your source (the example name is made up).
2. Deploy. The debug sidebar shows each still's statistics (`msg.ndi`).
3. Use **stop** and **start** to pause and resume (stop also disconnects from the source).

While no picture arrives, the endpoint answers 503 instead of showing an old picture.
Anyone who can reach Node-RED's HTTP endpoints can open the still, unless your settings set `httpNodeAuth`.

Needs the NDI Runtime on the Node-RED computer (https://ndi.video/tools/).

name: newest still, or 503
